title: DADA'S MIDNIGHT HUSTLE EXPOSED! 🛵
topic: The mystery of Dada's secret scooter and his midnight disappearing acts finally comes to a shocking conclusion.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: STOP RIGHT THERE DADA, I’VE TRACKED THE SCOOTER’S GPS STRAIGHT TO THIS BACK ALLEY! [beat] YOU CAN'T HIDE THE SECRET ANYMORE!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Nix, you little rascal, you always were too smart for your own good [beat] but you’ve interrupted a very delicate operation tonight.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: Dad? What on earth are you doing wearing leather chaps and a neon helmet [beat] in the middle of a Tuesday night? This is madness!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: We thought you were sleepwalking or losing your mind, but you’re out here [beat] looking like a retired superhero from a low-budget movie!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I saw the stacks of cash hidden in the garage, Dada! [beat] Just tell us the truth, are you actually running some kind of midnight smuggling ring?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Smuggling? Don’t be ridiculous, you brainless boy, I’m doing something [beat] much more lucrative and significantly more dangerous than that.

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Oh, just tell them already you old goat, before your daughter-in-law [beat] actually has a heart attack right here on the wet pavement.

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I am the top-rated 'Midnight Turbo' delivery driver in the entire city, [beat] and this scooter is a custom-built beast that hits sixty in three seconds!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: Wait, you’re the legendary 'Silver Bolt' who delivers five-star ramen [beat] to the suburbs faster than a police chase? That’s literally a TikTok myth!

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: I’ve been saving every single tip to buy back our old family workshop [beat] because none of you lazy kids have any real hustle left in your bones!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: So the midnight scooter wasn't a crime, it was just a [beat] high-speed side hustle to save our family history from being sold off to strangers?

lines.speaker: dada
lines.text: Exactly, now get on the back, Nix, [beat] we have three orders of spicy wings that need to be across town in exactly four minutes! Move it!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Some legends are born in fire, but Dada’s legend was built on [beat] midnight oil, high-speed turns, and the perfect customer delivery rating.
